text:
Most Product Owner training stops at Agile and Scrum. But real-world teams run on DevOps.

The self-paced DASA DevOps Product Owner Certification prepares you to lead across the full product lifecycle, from concept to continuous delivery.
→ Understand how DevOps changes what great product ownership looks like
→ Learn to balance speed, stability, and value across every stage
→ Build the confidence to guide teams, not just manage backlogs

Because Product Owners who understand DevOps lead the change.
